{{NPC infobox | icon = Battle Historian.png | location = World vs. World | race = Norn | level = 80 | service = Skirmish Merchant }} The [[Skirmish Supervisor]] is a [[merchant]] who accepts [[WvW Skirmish Claim Ticket]]s that can be found in every [[World versus World]] map.
== Locations == ;[[The Mists]] * [[Blue Alpine Borderlands]] ** [[Blue World Citadel]] ** [[Green World Border]] ** [[Red World Border]] * [[Edge of the Mists]] ** [[Badlands Docks]] ** [[Frostreach Docks]] ** [[Overgrown Docks]] * [[Eternal Battlegrounds]] ** [[Blue World Hill]] ** [[Green World Hill]] ** [[Red World Hill]] * [[Green Alpine Borderlands]] ** [[Blue World Border]] ** [[Green World Citadel]] ** [[Red World Border]] * [[Obsidian Sanctum]] ** [[Zraith's Beacon]] * [[Red Desert Borderlands]] ** [[Blue World Border]] ** [[Green World Border]] ** [[Red World Citadel]]
== Items offered == {{notice|Due to the substantial number of offers possibly available from Skirmish Supervisor, the inventory has been split across multiple pages.}} {{main|Skirmish Supervisor/Armor}} :* Exotic Armor :* Triumphant Ascended Armor :* Mistforged Triumphant Ascended Armor
{{main|Skirmish Supervisor/Weapons}} :* Exotic Weapons :* Ascended Weapons
{{main|Skirmish Supervisor/Others}} :* Ascended Vendor Recipes :* Ascended Trinkets :* Infusions :* Miscellaneous :* Historical
== Related achievements == *{{achievement|Infinite Arrow Cart}} *{{achievement|Infinite Ballista}} *{{achievement|Infinite Catapult}} *{{achievement|Infinite Flame Ram}} *{{achievement|Infinite Shield Generator}} *{{achievement|Infinite Siege Golem}} *{{achievement|Infinite Trebuchet}}
== Notes == * It takes {{token|wvw sct|1310}} [[WvW Skirmish Claim Ticket]]s in total to obtain a full set of [[Triumphant Hero's armor|Triumphant Hero's Ascended Armor]] and {{token|wvw sct|2620}} [[WvW Skirmish Claim Ticket]]s in total to obtain a full set of [[Mistforged Triumphant Hero's armor|Mistforged Triumphant Hero's Ascended Armor]].
